name: updateRings
description: Windows Update for Business rings with their deferral, deadline, pause and rollback settings (beta API)

metadata.name: state
metadata.valueExpression: {{ (() => { const q = $['qualityUpdatesPaused'] === true; const f = $['featureUpdatesPaused'] === true; if (q && f) { return 'Quality and feature updates paused'; } if (q) { return 'Quality updates paused'; } if (f) { return 'Feature updates paused'; } return 'Active'; })() }}

metadata.name: qualityPauseExpires
metadata.valueExpression: {{ (() => { if ($['qualityUpdatesPaused'] !== true) { return null; } const d = $['qualityUpdatesPauseExpiryDateTime']; const t = d === null || d === undefined ? NaN : new Date(d).getTime(); return isNaN(t) || new Date(t).getUTCFullYear() <= 1901 ? null : d; })() }}

metadata.name: featurePauseExpires
metadata.valueExpression: {{ (() => { if ($['featureUpdatesPaused'] !== true) { return null; } const d = $['featureUpdatesPauseExpiryDateTime']; const t = d === null || d === undefined ? NaN : new Date(d).getTime(); return isNaN(t) || new Date(t).getUTCFullYear() <= 1901 ? null : d; })() }}

metadata.name: qualityRollbackStart
metadata.valueExpression: {{ (() => { const d = $['qualityUpdatesRollbackStartDateTime']; const t = d === null || d === undefined ? NaN : new Date(d).getTime(); return isNaN(t) || new Date(t).getUTCFullYear() <= 1901 ? null : d; })() }}

metadata.name: featureRollbackStart
metadata.valueExpression: {{ (() => { const d = $['featureUpdatesRollbackStartDateTime']; const t = d === null || d === undefined ? NaN : new Date(d).getTime(); return isNaN(t) || new Date(t).getUTCFullYear() <= 1901 ? null : d; })() }}

metadata.name: automaticUpdateBehavior
metadata.valueExpression: {{ (() => { const m = $['automaticUpdateMode']; if (typeof m !== 'string') { return null; } return ({ userDefined: 'User defined', notifyDownload: 'Notify download', autoInstallAtMaintenanceTime: 'Auto install at maintenance time', autoInstallAndRebootAtMaintenanceTime: 'Auto install and restart at maintenance time', autoInstallAndRebootAtScheduledTime: 'Auto install and restart at a scheduled time', autoInstallAndRebootWithoutEndUserControl: 'Auto install and restart without end-user control', windowsDefault: 'Reset to default' })[m] || m; })() }}
